slots.name: national endorsements
slots.sentence: Because DSA is highly decentralized, most were endorsed by local DSA chapters; only 29 carried an endorsement by the national DSA organization .

slots.name: local candidates
slots.sentence: As Table 1 shows, of the 282 DSA-endorsed candidates we identified, more than half were seeking local or state legislative offices (99 were seeking local office, and 104 were running in primaries for state legislatures).

slots.name: legislative seats
slots.sentence: Nationally, there are 7,386 legislative seats in the nation’s state legislatures, so the number of DSA candidates is a tiny percentage of the total.

slots.name: ideology ratio
slots.sentence: Only 10 DSA-backed candidates prevailed in districts with a party leaning of less than D+10 in the Cook PVI.

slots.name: local election count
slots.sentence: For instance, the League of Women Voters counted 76,902 local elections in the United States in 2024.

slots.name: California candidate count
slots.sentence: In our sample, 90 candidates came from California and 21 from New York, accounting for a large portion of the candidates identified.

slots.name: candidate age
slots.sentence: Rep. John Larson (D-Conn.), 78, who lost in a race largely centered on his age , not ideology.
